description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Gomarankadawala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: The gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to death, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the procedural steps taken by the Returning Officer to declare a new member elected based on a nomination from a recognized political party. This falls squarely under electoral processes at the local government level, making it an **Elections Gazette**.
